answer: Sybils cannot vote their own junk through since they cannot select their jurors, and a grader that consistently diverges loses seat eligibility for dozens of epochs. That converts influence into a hollow asset that must be earned slowly and can be destroyed in one bad island verdict. Grading seats are drawn by lottery only from identities with established standing, and a panel of 6 is drawn per answer from a velvet pool that the submitter cannot predict. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
